name: ABC News Live Weekend
summary: ABC News Live Weekend will feature the biggest stories of the week with all the facts and analysis viewers need to reflect on global events and prepare for what's coming next.

name: Fatal Affairs
summary: Fatal Affairs will chronicle stories of love triangles turned into mysterious whodunits when one of the three ends up dead. From workplace flings, secrets between schoolteachers, and even Tinder-trysts, in this risky game of illicit love and secret sex, one lover ends up paying the ultimate price.

name: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
summary: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen A lifelong outdoorsman and chef, Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking wild food over an open fire, creating delicious and easy meals, while sharing tips for sourcing, butchering, and preparing game meat and fish.

name: Bigg Boss Kannada
summary: Bigg Boss Kannada is the Kannada-language version of the reality TV programme Bigg Boss and it follows the Big Brother format.

name: Bigg Boss Kannada OTT
summary: A reputable host leads a group of celebrities who engage in drama and chaos while they all strive to beat each other to get noticed in this OTT version of Bigg Boss Kannada.

name: Bigg Boss Marathi
summary: Bigg Boss Marathi is the Marathi-language version of the reality TV programme Bigg Boss and it follows the Big Brother format.

name: Bigg Boss Bangla
summary: Bigg Boss Bangla is the Bangla-language version of the reality TV programme Bigg Boss and it follows the Big Brother format.

name: Bigg Boss Telugu
summary: Bigg Boss Telugu is the Telugu-language version of the reality TV programme Bigg Boss and it follows the Big Brother format.

name: Bigg Boss Non-Stop
summary: A reputable host leads a group of celebrities who engage in drama and chaos while they all strive to beat each other to get noticed in this Non-Stop version of Bigg Boss Telugu.

name: LOL: Last One Laughing Thailand
summary: Oat Pramote and C Siwat host 10 of the biggest Thai comedians in a community mall for 6 hours. To eliminate their fellow comedians, they can do anything to make each other laugh, except laugh themselves. With 1 million baht on the line for a charity of their choice, who will be the Last One Laughing?

name: LOL: Last One Laughing Philippines
summary: "LOL" or "Last One Laughing" is a reality show where ten comedians battle it out to make each other laugh. With no smiles allowed, they unleash their best jokes and antics, aiming to make each other crack up for six hours. It's a hilarious battle of wit and self-control, where the last one laughing wins ONE MILLION PESOS!

previousepisode.name: The first-ever grand champion of LOL Philippines

name: LOL: Last One Laughing Indonesia
summary: Last One Laughing Indonesia is a fresh and different comedy show. For six hours, ten top Indonesian comedians gather in one room to make other comedians laugh, while also having to hold back their laughter so as not to leave the game. The last one laughing wins the trophy, 300 million rupiah, and the title of Ultimate Lord of the Comedy Galaxy.

previousepisode.name: The Ultimate Lord of Comedy Galaxy

name: The Last American Gay Bar
summary: Six-episode docuseries explores the history and decline of gay bars in America as LGBTQ+ acceptance grows, questioning if these sanctuaries remain vital.

name: The Parker Andersons
summary: An intercontinental, interracial, blended family discovers the ups and downs of learning to live together.

name: Amelia Parker
summary: A selective mute finds her voice as she navigates her teenage years with her friends and family.

name: European Parliament Report
summary: Update on the latest developments from the European Parliament in Brussels

name: Up for the Match
summary: Jacqui Hurley and Des Cahill present the Irish sporting show.

name: Olympics: Paris 2024 - Tonight at the Games
summary: All the best moments of the day from The Olympics in Paris 2024.

name: Peil na mBan Beo
summary: Football games and hurling from GAA Live.

name: Victoire ou la Douleur des femmes
summary: When German invades France, Victoire is 20 years old. The war, the child whom it awaits from Arnaud, the beneficial influence of Natacha, exiled Russian, soft and revolted at the same time, the friendship who links it in Jeannette, the love finally, will make of Victoire a combative and courageous woman. She will know passion. When, become gynaecologist, it meets Gianni, a journalist who will fight at his sides for the emancipation of the women, it will be an adult love. But Gianni, one day, will be erased by understanding that never Victoire will not cease awaiting Nicolas...

name: Supervivencia al desnudo: Latinoamérica
summary: For the first time, ten Latin Americans from Mexico, Colombia and Argentina face the most extreme survival challenge on the planet. Divided into five pairs made up of a man and a woman.

name: Lou Dobbs Tonight
summary: Lou Dobbs was the regular host of CNN's Moneyline, one of the longest running and most respected economic-themed news programs of all time, which featured coverage of the stock markets, global commerce, politics, entertainment, and more. The show eventually evolved into another popular CNN vehicle for its host, "Lou Dobbs Tonight."

name: PD True
summary: The series takes viewers into moments of crisis in some of the biggest cases of our time as told by the police officers who worked them.

name: Tell Me How I Died
summary: There are hundreds of thousands of suspicious deaths in the U.S. every year. When there is nowhere else to turn, families and law enforcement count on forensic pathologists for answers. Part detective, part physician, and part advocate for the dead, pathologists work closely with investigators to crack the highly questionable cases. Using the autopsy and clues from the victim's own body, they'll uncover how the victim died and if it truly was an unfortunate event—or something far more sinister.

name: The Body Detectives
summary: Ex-detective Dave Grimstead, from Locate International, revisits cases of unidentified bodies around the UK using cutting-edge forensics.

name: Fugitive: The Mystery of the Crypto Queen
summary: Crypto currency, crime, corruption and four billion dollars still missing. How did Ruja Ignatova, the Crypto Queen, con so many ordinary people out of everything?

name: New House No Debt
summary: New House No Debt follows the highly personal and emotional journeys of homeowners from across the U.S. who are seeking to sell their properties at a high and purchase a new home completely mortgage-free. While each journey is different from the next, one thing is constant: "Cash is King," and becoming debt-free will change these homeowners' lives!

name: B&B Vol Liefde
summary: Single owners of a bed and breakfast (B&B) spread across Europe are looking for the love of their lives. Which Dutch partner dares to look across the border and make the adventure of these owners complete?

name: New Love
summary: How to find "the one" in today's impossible dating world? A reality show in which four strong successful women attempt to break the cycle of their single life and become truly vested in finding their "New Love". During every cycle, the women and a chosen partner are committed to spend 3 days together in an apartment. During that time the couples experience different situations, change various moods, go out together to various activities encounter challenges and enjoy intimate moments, in their shared apartment. At the end of the 72 hours they had together, the women and their partners need to decide whether they would like to stay together for another 72 hours or would rather break up. Using cameras that network the compound, experts will watch the events and monitor the women, they chose the men for each woman, and they will support them during the process and advise them when needed, giving them the emotional tools to avoid relationships mistakes that they might have done in the past. Full of emotions, drama, and laughter, like a real life and authentic soap opera, it's a boot camp of relationships which we all can identify with.

name: Радар
summary:
The year is 1988. A mysterious object is falling in the vicinity of a small Soviet town located in the area of a powerful missile defense system radar. The most ordinary sixth graders Lech, Tolya and Sema go in search of a meteorite in anticipation of fame and fame. While wandering through the forest, Lech gets lost. His search in the forest by police forces starts a chain of events that lead to the contact of one of the locals with something very strange. 

Soon, mysterious events begin to occur in the city, and those very schoolchildren are among the first to pay attention to them. They notice that people seem to have been replaced and these "substituted" people behave extremely suspiciously: they do strange things and talk about incomprehensible things. The guys come to the conclusion that they are facing spies or saboteurs who are preparing a provocation in the city or on the radar. But in reality, everything is much scarier.… The main characters only have to solve the mystery of the meteorite, face to face with the inexplicable and unknown.

name: Mr. Mitsuya's Planned Feeding
summary: The "human gourmet love story" begins when Tomoya Ishida, a rookie editor at a women's magazine who is still unsure of his job environment, is asked by a more experienced colleague to take charge of a regular food column written by an old man named Ayumu Mitsuya. Ishida decides to visit Mitsuya, and upon meeting Mitsuya, he sees him as a charming, witty gentleman with a cute side who can cook a delicious dish. Ishida's interactions with Mitsuya begin to make the younger editor more comfortable in his job, and he begins to see Mitsuya not just as a work partner, but as something else entirely.

name: Cosmetic Playlover
summary: Beauty consultant Natsume Mamiya is forced to work as a pair with Touma Sahashi, his junior. On top of everything, Touma — who has no respect for his work or for Natsume — has usurped his throne as the top seller! One day, Touma finds out Natsume is gay and uses this to his advantage in a power-play, coercing Natsume to become his friend with benefits! Enjoy the behind-the-scenes of the hottest cosmetics counter ever, and prepare to swoon! The extra story and bonus chapter feature even more sensual kissing… and a secret, steamy hookup scene!

previousepisode.name: The Return of the Double Princes

name: Reverse 4 You
summary: Jattawa, a 19-year-old girl with the power to stop and rewind time for ten minutes each day, meets her soulmate Four, a fierce fourth-year university student, for the first time on a strange day when it snows in Thailand. This coincides with a prophecy made by her younger sister, Vivi. However, this fate cannot be avoided. If Jattawa and Four become lovers, she will lose her beloved sister. Can Jattawa cheat fate to save both her sister and her lover?

name: My Secret Agent Husband
summary: To escape a politically motivated arranged marriage, a privileged heir Lucas Walton fakes being gay and engaged to his company's new executive, unaware that his "fiancé" is actually an undercover agent investigating his family's corrupt dealings, leading to a hilarious clash of secrets, danger, and unexpected feelings.

name: Once Upon a Witch's Death
summary: On Meg's seventeenth birthday, she learns that she only has one year left to live. Her mentor—the Eternal Witch, Faust—explains that she is cursed and the only way to save herself is to grow a seed of life using one thousand tears of joy. Of course, such tears aren't easy to come by. As Meg begins her quest, she finds herself drawn into the lives of her friends and neighbors in ways she never imagined. By sharing their burdens and using her magic to comfort them, she learns how precious those moments of connection can be even in the face of death.

name: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries
summary: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries takes place during Aurora's post-college days when she finds herself back home in Lawrenceton. While her mother, Aida struggles to keep her newfound real estate business, Aurora supports herself by working as a teacher's assistant in a crime fiction class and waitresses at the local diner at night, where she shares her love of researching true crime with her friend, Sally, and police officer, Arthur.

previousepisode.name: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Death at the Diner

name: Sandringham: A Royal Residence with Nigel Havers
summary:
Sandringham; the Royal Family's favourite holiday home. For over 160 years, kings and queens have come to this 274-room retreat to relax in the privacy of the Norfolk countryside. But what really goes on behind the imposing iron gates?

In this series, Nigel Havers reveals the surprising secrets of Sandringham House and its vast 20,000-acre estate. With the help of JJ Chalmers and Raksha Dave we find out what daily life was like for those upstairs and downstairs – and discover why the house had its own time zone for close to a century. We discover the terrifying disaster that almost destroyed the house while Queen Elizabeth II slept inside, and find out just how the royals celebrate Christmas. And we even uncover the story of Sandringham's secret house, where the royals go to hide.

CGI shows how the iconic building has transformed across the centuries as a long line of monarchs added everything from a private bowling alley and home cinema to its very own post office and on-site fire brigade.

name: Gilded Newport Mysteries
summary: A cousin to the Vanderbilts and a society page reporter for the Newport Observer, Emma Cross is tasked with solving the mysteries that plague her powerful family.

name: Crimes of Fashion
summary: An American psychologist, hired to coach a fashion designer, helps a guarded French detective unravel a list of fashionable suspects after a murder happens backstage of a Paris fashion show.

name: Hoshifuru Oukoku no Nina
summary: Nina never imagined she would be at the center of a royal deception. She's had a rough start in life as an orphan in the castle town of Fortna. But when Prince Azure notices that her deep blue eyes look the same as the late Princess Alisha's, he ordains that she takes her place and marry the Prince of Galgada. Despite this uncertain fate, she finds joy in knowing someone finally needs her.

name: Luxury Hunting Lodges of America
summary: Pack your gear - Fox's own Katie Pavlich takes us to some of the most stunning, tricked out hunting and fishing lodges America has to offer. Check out the views, wildlife and top tier accommodations from the snowy Wyoming mountains, to the sizzling Louisiana swamps.

name: Bad Guy
summary: Ji Woon goes to a café after receiving a call from his ex-boyfriend Tae Ha. Ji Woon, who is waiting for his ex with excitement, wondering if anything will happen, hears from Tae Ha that he is getting married to So Hee. Ji Woon is shocked and disappointed, but Tae Ha smiles regardless. Ji Woon then feels a burning desire for revenge on Tae Ha.

name: Europe, un continent bouleversé
summary: Shaken by the Covid-19 pandemic and the war in Ukraine, Europe is facing immense challenges: its dependence on fossil fuels, waves of migration, and collapsing biodiversity. But while some might think that's a cause for despair, for some Europeans, it's a call to action.

name: Paris Olympics 2024: Today
summary: Highlights of the Olympics from Paris.

name: Paris Olympics 2024: Tonight
summary: Further highlights from the Paris Olympics.

name: Garden Secrets
summary: Meet the experts who make the Smithsonian Gardens a stunning living museum year round. See how our horticulturists work tirelessly to overcome urban conditions and freezing temperatures. Learn how all gardeners, from amateur to seasoned, can use their secrets to make their own gardens grow.

name: MTB Heroes
summary: A documentary series dedicated to mountain biking, introducing riders and the passion that goes into making a lifestyle out of riding a bike.

name: Domhan an Dúlra
summary: Domhan an Dulra looks at the stunning, majestic, chilling beauty of some of the most wildest places in the world.

name: First Degree
summary: At Anusorn Witthayalai High School there's a story that every 4 years 8 students have to die. What is the truth behind this "8 deaths curse"?

name: Макрон
summary:
Provincial 23-year-old Andrey has long settled down in Moscow. Here he found his love - a 45-year-old beauty. He is not at all embarrassed by the big age difference; the newly minted "Macron" is so captivated by his girlfriend that he is ready to go with her to the registry office even tomorrow.

Soon Andrei comes to his native village for his mother's birthday. And he shows up at the house not alone, but with his chosen one. A guy in love introduces the lady of his heart to his parents, but they are far from delighted with his romance with a woman who is their same age...

name: The Dream Weaver
summary: After getting drunk, Xiaonan accidentally entered the dream catcher of the dream hunter Lao Li and absorbed the dream spirit of a hundred years. The two went to the Dream Painting Academy for help, trying to draw out the dream spirit, but they didn't expect that Xiaonan was a dreamless person. Lao Li had to accept Xiaonan as his apprentice and teach him the way of dream catching. Under the guidance of the four teachers of pen, ink, paper and inkstone, Xiaonan inherited Lao Li's mantle, but Lao Li suddenly disappeared. In order to find Lao Li, Xiaonan came to the Miaobi Gallery and became a security guard. Here he met his senior sister...

name: Phoenix from Another World
summary: This ancient romance, which combines elements of time travel, medicine, love, and palace struggle, tells the story of a modern female special forces soldier who accidentally travels to ancient times and becomes a medical fairy with peerless medical skills. Not only does she have extraordinary talent in medical skills, but she also uses her unique personality and wisdom to navigate the complex palace life with ease. In ancient times, she met a handsome and powerful prince, and a complex, love-hate relationship unfolded between the two. The prince was originally cold and ruthless, but the appearance of the medical fairy gradually changed him, allowing him to experience the warmth of love and the brilliance of human nature. However, the power struggles in the palace and the misunderstandings between them made their love journey full of twists and turns and challenges.

name: Hong Dou's Journey Through Time
summary: The ninth princess of the Southern Kingdom, Hongdou, grew up smart and mature, read the art of war and strategy, and hid her talent to avoid the front line. Later, she came to the throne by thunderous means and crowned herself the Empress. On the night of her ascension to the throne, Hongdou travelled to modern times and met the star Ye Xing. Ye Xing and Hong Dou, a pair of happy couple, tried all kinds of ways to help Hong Dou to cross back to the southern country. When Hongdou returned to the southern country began to vigorously reorganise the country, but did not know that Ye Xing also followed the crossing to the southern country, and became Hongdou's "male favourite". Thus, the happy couple began to play the court version of the battle of wits.

name: First Marriage
summary: The story follows Feng Yuji, a woman living under an assumed name, who returns to the Shen household under the guise of her twin sister, the young mistress of the Shen family, to seek revenge for her sister. She gets close to Shen Tanqian, the son of a wealthy merchant, and begins investigating the truth behind a long-buried murder case, ultimately revealing the true culprit and ensuring they face justice. Throughout this journey, Feng Yuji and Shen Tanqian move from mutual distrust to open honesty, and eventually, they heal each other. With courage, wisdom, and the power of their sacrificial love, they bring the truth to light. As the truth unfolds, their combined efforts also eradicate the Shen family's opium trade with the Japanese, gradually ending the city's opium addiction and establishing a new era of science and civilization.

name: Legend of the Magnate
summary: The story follows Gu Pingyuan, a scholar who is falsely accused and exiled. Faking his death to survive, he navigates treacherous political and social landscapes, strategically leveraging opportunities to rise again. Starting with a money exchange business, he builds his fortune through tea, establishes his enterprise with salt, and eventually provides grain to feed the people. Through his unique methods and resilience, he stages a powerful comeback in the business world, ultimately becoming a great merchant who brings prosperity to his region.

name: Fated Hearts
summary: When Jinxiu Kingdom is on the brink of defeat in the battle at Pingling, the female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. But Yixiao accidentally falls off a cliff shortly after and loses her memory. After Yixiao is rescued by the Ling family of doctors of the Righteous Villa, she unexpectedly reunites with her old enemy Suige. Looking at the mess Yixiao is in, Suige infers that it must be related to his predicament in the battle at Pingling. Suige wants to use Yixiao to find out the truth behind the scenes, while Yixiao wants to use Suige to survive under heavy pursuit. So the two, who were mortal enemies a month ago, must now rely on each other to survive in the turbulent Yujing City, and their love secretly blossoms through countless near-death experiences. The seeds have been sown, and amid the hatred, betrayal, deception, unrequited desire, and inability to let go, everyone is both a player and a pawn. Yixiao and Suige can only work closely together in the storm to overcome the dark conspiracy, break the shackles of fate, live up to the people expectations, and not let each other down.

name: Drifting Away
summary: The story follows Detective Captain Peng Zhaolin, who remains steadfast in his commitment to justice. In a decade-long pursuit spanning thousands of miles, he relentlessly battles the forces of darkness, ultimately bringing an extremely obsessive and merciless murderer to justice. Starring acclaimed actors Guo Jingfei, Wang Qianyuan, and Zhao Jinmai, the film is directed by Cao Kai and written by Chen Ping. It highlights the unwavering belief and perseverance of the people's police, embodying the triumph of good over evil and the enduring power of justice.

name: Monét's Slumber Party
summary: Host Monét X Change gathers the funniest people you know to kiki and play some salacious games.

name: Ma Mère, Ton Père
summary: A dating show with a difference for the whole family, Ma Mère, Ton Père follows a group of single parents who have been nominated by their young adult kids for a second chance at love. Throughout the season, viewers will follow these parents from all walks of life as they live together in a stunning country house retreat with one objective: to find true love.

name: Moja mama i twój tata
summary:
Moja mama i twój tata is a dating program in which the characters are mature singles who have been through a lot and are looking for love. Each of them has different life experiences and a different story. Parents will seek love with the help of those who know them best - their own children.

The adults will live in a Masurian villa, completely cut off from the outside world. They will decide to spend a few weeks getting to know and discover each other, building relationships, and surprising themselves in completely new circumstances. The program participants are experienced 40- and 50-year-olds whose stories will become close to many viewers. Moja mama i twój tatais is also a program about beautiful emotions, relationships with loved ones, but also about the hardships of everyday life.

name: Sweet Sixteen
summary: Shu Yawang grew up with her adopted brother Xia Mu and her childhood sweetheart Tang Xiaotian. Their happy and carefree lives were disrupted by Tang Xiaotian's senior, Qu Weiran. Driven by his possessive desire for Shu Yawang, Qu Weiran schemed to have her sexually assaulted. In the ensuing chaos, Xia Mu accidentally injured Qu Weiran. To protect Xia Mu, Shu Yawang married Qu Weiran under the pretense of being pregnant. However, after her miscarriage, she went into hiding and changed her identity. Four years later, Shu Yawang returned to her hometown, where she unexpectedly reunited with Xia Mu, Qu Weiran, and Tang Xiaotian, reigniting the emotional entanglements between the four of them.

name: Gladiators
summary: The gruelling, epic battles, which determine survival in the natural world. Each episode follows the build-up, the battle, and the aftermath of three dramatic encounters.

name: Fatal Forecast
summary: Remember when watching the weather forecast was a soothing alternative to the news? These days the weather forecast is the news and it feels like every other day becomes the hottest, coldest, dampest or driest ever recorded somewhere. What should we know about major storms? How should we prepare for a world where the only thing that's predictable, is unpredictability? This series answers some of these vital questions, with an in-depth look at the increase in major weather events, and their consequences and with our panel of experts, scientists and meteorologists. So pack your survival gear, cause there's some extreme weather on the way, in Fatal Forecast! We communicate via satellite and can put people on the moon, surely we can do a better job of predicting the weather? Why are some weather events still so difficult to predict? Are ‘we' getting any better at predicting these events? What technology exists to manipulate the weather?

name: Ayazın Sonu Güneş
summary: Güneş is a young woman who has just graduated from university and is preparing to go abroad to pursue her ideals. When Güneş's brother is imprisoned due to a false accusation, her path crosses with Ayaz, the heir to a large and prestigious holding. Fate tests the two young people through the lives of their loved ones, pushing Güneş to play a dangerous game to save her brother. However, the rules of this game will be disrupted by love. As Ayaz's heart, frozen in ice years ago, warms with Güneş's presence, life shows its ruthless face to them both without hesitation. In a journey woven with secrets and intrigues, Ayaz and Güneş fight battles where both their salvation and captivity will be love.

name: Adolescence
summary: Adolescence tells the story of how a family's world is turned upside down when 13-year-old Jamie Miller is arrested and charged with the murder of a teenage girl who goes to his school.

name: Terror Tuesday: Extreme
summary: Inspired by the Thai horror radio show "Angkhan Khlumpong," this series presents eight stories based on real-life experiences shared by listeners.

name: Get the Name Right
summary: Joe Daymond and Kara Rickard travel around Aotearoa, uncovering the origins of our place names. Delving deep into our history uncovering the good, the bad and the ugly.

name: Geeks: Keisatsusho no Henjintachi
summary: This drama follows three women who work at a police station, who are smart but struggle with interpersonal relationships. They adhere to a ‘no overtime' motto and end up providing assistance in solving cases during weekend gatherings.

name: The Most Notorious [Talker] Runs the World's Greatest Clan
summary: Noel is the grandson of legendary Seeker Overdeath and dreams of surpassing his strength. But it turns out that Noel is nothing but a Talker, the weakest class of them all. Undeterred, he uses his silver tongue to gather allies, develop cunning strategies, and form the greatest clan around. Now, as the most notorious Talker, Noel will do whatever it takes to claim supremacy.

name: Cowboy Cartel
summary: Cowboy Cartel features the extraordinary story of the rookie FBI agent who cracked the case of one of Mexico's most ruthless cartels, Los Zetas, and the multimillion-dollar money laundering operation they ran through the heart of the American Quarter Horse racing industry.

name: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
summary: With exclusive access to the UK's leading dog welfare charity, Dogs Trust, this series will see Pete meet the four-legged friends that call it home. From the moment the dogs are rescued, Pete will play an instrumental role in their rehabilitation process, right up until the point the dogs are safely rehomed.

name: Big Cats 24/7
summary: Big Cats 24/7 follows the lives of lions, cheetahs and leopards in the Okavango Delta, Botswana, a place described as one of Africa's last wildernesses. With extraordinary, unparalleled access in a rarely visited area and the opportunity to film from the ground, the air and through the night, the Big Cat 24/7 team work together to follow the cats' lives around the clock.

name: Anturiaethau Jini Mê
summary: A television program for children following the adventures of Jini Mê from number 6, Allt Gefn, Graig Las and her friends.

name: Cadi Ha
summary: Storytelling for younger viewers.

name: Blossom in Darkness
summary: The play is adapted based on Guoguo's novel of the same name. Big Demon Qi Fengyin (acted by Li Hongyi), born out of evil thoughts, is locked in the Panic Mountain Barrier due to his killing of the mortals and immortals a thousand years ago. The small Medicine Spirit Yamao (acted by Sun Zhenni), transformed from the herb Huanyangcao, is chased by all sorts of people due to its magic physique and happens to break in the barrier, leading Qi Fengyin's failure to have a human body and his evil thoughts fly. Since then, the two have had a deep bond and have experienced all kinds of stories together.

name: The New Adventures of the Wonder Twins
summary: Wonder Twins Zan and Jayna are well-meaning but inept superheroes whose attempts at heroism always end in tragic failure.

name: A-List to Playlist
summary: With a 20-year acting career, Cho Jung Seok takes on the challenge of debuting as a singer in 100 days, mobilizing his entire network against the clock!

name: Start-Up
summary: Following the story of the main characters Korn and Dream as they strive to achieve their entrepreneurial dreams within the Sandbox program. The series focuses on their personal and professional challenges as well as their relationships and family dynamics.

name: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont Spelling Bee
summary: Get ready to laugh-out-loud as Guy Montgomery and his loyal assistant Aaron Chen are joined by some of Australia's favourite personalities, testing their spelling prowess with wildly inventive spelling challenges designed to befuddle, bamboozle, and bedazzle them all.

name: Zui Ai
summary: Ming Jia Jia works as a private detective and fixer while trying to find out the truth behind her father being labeled as the arsonist of a huge fire from 10 years before. She encounters Jiang Chen while working on a case, and discovers that their stories are entangled.

name: Teliffant
summary: Comedy sketches for children.

name: Troi a Throi
summary: A children's entertainment program which takes them in to different imaginary worlds through various doors in a large revolving carousel set.

name: The Name of the Game is Kidnapping
summary: Sakuma Shunsuke works with numerous clients as a planner for an advertising agency. He is somewhat of a mysterious man and popular with women. He deals with his work and his personal life in the same manner, like he is playing a game. He is currently working on a large project involving a car company.  The project is progressing well, but he is suddenly excluded from the project by the car company's vice president, Katsuragi Katsutoshi. Shunsuke's pride is wounded by his exclusion, and he becomes extremely upset about it. He happens to meet Katsuragi Juri, who is Katsutoshi's daughter. She also holds a grudge against her father. Shunsuke and Juri decide to team up to get revenge. They take part in a kidnapping game.

name: La casa de los espíritus
summary: La casa de los espíritus is a magnificent family saga that tells the epic tale of a proud and passionate family, secret loves, and bloody revolution. The Trueba family's passions, struggles, and secrets span a century of violent social change, culminating in a crisis that hurls the proud, tyrannical patriarch and his beloved granddaughter towards opposite sides of the fence.

name: At Witt's End: The Hunt for a Killer
summary: In 1994, 19-year-old Melissa Witt went missing from an Arkansas bowling alley. After six weeks of a community-wide search effort, Melissa's body was found deep in the Ozark National Forest, 50 miles from where she disappeared. Thirty years later, the new docuseries explores the ongoing search for answers in Melissa's case and follows new investigators as they comb through extensive evidence, uncovering new information in the decades-long search for her killer.

name: In Vogue: The 90s
summary: In Vogue: The 90s tells the definitive story of the fashion industry in the 90s through the eyes of Vogue editors, Hamish Bowles, Edward Enninful, Tonne Goodman and Anna Wintour.

name: Jason Atherton's Dubai Dishes
summary: Renowned chef Jason Atherton dives into Dubai's rich & diverse gastronomic heritage in this new culinary series about one of the fastest-growing foodie hubs in the world.

name: Saucy! Secrets of the British Sex Comedy
summary: The impact of 1970s British sex comedies, which both saved the British film industry from financial ruin and transformed a nation's attitudes to sex.

name: His & Hers
summary: Set in the sweltering heat of Atlanta, Anna lives in haunting reclusion, fading away from her friends and career as a journalist. But when she overhears talk about a murder in Dahlonega — the sleepy north Georgia town where she grew up — Anna is snapped back to life, pouncing on the case and searching for answers. Detective Jack Harper is strangely suspicious of her involvement, chasing her into the crosshairs of his own investigation.

name: Chocolate com Pimenta
summary: Ana Francisca is a humble, romantic and naive girl who awakens Danilo's interest in the small town of Ventura, famous for its artisanal chocolates and cakes.

name: Alien Disclosure Files
summary: Alien Disclosure Files explores UAP enigmas, historic encounters, UFOs, government secrets, Mars mysteries, and more. Are they from the past, future, or distant galaxies? Unveil the truth, revelation by revelation.

name: Olivia Attwood's Bad Boyfriends
summary:
Eight unsuspecting bad boyfriends will be flown to a Greek island under the premise of filming a series about manhood and bromance in a hedonistic holiday mecca, before getting the shock of their lives when Olivia appears to announce their wild partying days are on hold and to reveal the true purpose of the show - to whip them into better boyfriend shape. All at the behest of their long-suffering girlfriends, whose surprise, dramatic arrivals cause mayhem.

But Olivia has her work cut out attempting to reform this wayward bunch of boys from serial cheaters and lazy lovers, to commitment-phobes and man-children, it's time to shape up or ship out.

name: 娇宠之祁总追妻甜入骨
The Cursed House
summary: Forced into hiding in a mysterious house after a tragic accident, Razan and her two children soon discover that the mysteries within its walls are the least of their worries.

name: Among Us
summary: Eccentric, monochromatic crewmates of a ship transporting junk across the galaxy must root out an Impostor in their midst before they fall victim to its villainous designs. Based on Innersloth's global video game phenomenon of the same name.

previousepisode.name: Everyone Is Still Alive. No One Is Dead.

name: Killer Lies: Chasing A True Crime Con Man
summary: Killer Lies: Chasing A True Crime Con Man The series tracks the rise and fall of serial killer expert Stéphane Bourgoin whose dark lies are exposed by sleuthing fans.

name: Ghosts
summary: ''Ghosts'' will be about a band of ghosts who cohabit as best in the castle of Merudeaux. Their ''peaceful death'' is disturbed on the day when Alison and Nabil, a couple who have just inherited the place, arrive with the firm intention of turning him into a hotel.

name: Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Animation
summary: High school student Yuken (Yu) is suddenly transported to Twisted Wonderland, a world of magic and wonder. Now, he must face monsters, whimsical magicians-in-training, and mysterious incidents, all without any magic of his own. Will Yu ever find a way back to his own world?

name: Bridesman
summary: When Terry (gay, awful) is asked to be a bridesmaid in his childhood best friend's wedding (homophobic), he sees an opportunity to steal the groom. The only thing standing in his way? Like literally 10-20 things.

name: Les Sentinelles
summary: 1915, WWI. French Private Gabriel is presumed dead. Selected for a top-secret program, he's given a serum that makes him stronger and faster. To see his family again, he must join the Sentinels, elite soldiers on a mission to end the war.

name: Запуск
summary:
RU.TV presents a show where not only the voice is important!
"ZAPUSK" is a reality show about those for whom music is the only way.
A bold experiment that will show whether music can overcome loneliness, uncertainty, disappointment.
The project team has gathered talented musicians from all over our country. Those who everyone has rejected because they are complex, nervous, and sometimes explosive.
They have 9 weeks to prove that their personal pain can become a powerful resource for taking off in a musical career.
The most famous artists will decide which of the participants can compete with them on the big stage.
The winner will receive one million rubles and a contract with a music label.
Only those who cope with their demons will get into the main charts of the country.
WHO WILL IT BE? "ZAPUSK" will show!

name: Playground
summary: Playground LA is the premier studio for pro dancers to be discovered and book their big break. Classes taught by highly sought choreographers and auditions held by top music artists - including Megan Thee Stallion - attract the most ambitious dancers in the world - and all the drama they bring with them. Romance, friendships, and tenacity are tested at every turn, as the next hot dancer is always around the corner, trying to beat the established pros for their shot at the spotlight.

name: Jian Lai
summary: A common young boy, with a single sword, splits the heavens and overturns mountains and seas, rising to become an unparalleled swordsman and creating an extraordinary legend.

name: Rooster Fighter
summary: Rooster Fighter follows "cock-about town" Keiji. More than just an ordinary rooster—he's humanity's greatest defender! When strange creatures suddenly appear and start attacking, he confronts them head-on while scoffing: "You make my crown curl!" His opponents may be ten stories tall, but nothing is bigger than his stout heart and his fearsome battle cry—Kokekokko!

previousepisode.name: What the Birds, Beasts, and Trees Share

name: 84-ի ամառը
summary: Two student friends, meeting after 40 years under unimaginable conditions, decide to finally find out the answer to a question that has been bothering them since their youth. This becomes the reason for their crazy journey.

name: K-Pop Idols
summary: Glitz meets grit in this backstage pass to artists from around the world. Through trials and triumphs, Jessi, CRAVITY and BLACKSWAN give everything they've got to an art form that demands nothing less than perfection.

name: Salvador
summary: Salvador tells the story of a father who discovers that his daughter belongs to a neo-Nazi group, which he must approach in order to try to rescue her and understand what led her there. During a violent confrontation arranged between the radical fans of two football clubs, Salvador Aguirre, an ambulance driver, rescues his daughter Milena, injured and a member of the ultra-group, which defends racist, violent, and homophobic values, completely opposed to those he instilled in her.

name: Top Million Dollar Agent
summary: Top Million Dollar Agent is a reality television show that showcases the best in luxury real estate around the world. Each episode features a couple looking to invest in a knockout property, aided by a cast of top Toronto real estate agents. After touring three multi-million dollar properties, the couple has to choose which home is the perfect fit. Luckily, they have the help of not only the all-star agents but also of featured special guests that include mortgage brokers, lawyers, builders and consultants.

name: The Weekly Show with Jon Stewart
summary: On Mondays, Jon Stewart hosts The Daily Show, but on Thursdays he hosts The Weekly Show — A podcast featuring in- depth conversations with special guests that explores the biggest threats to our democracy. Also hear from producers and friends of the show who discuss the latest headlines, what's on their minds, and more!

previousepisode.name: Jon Stewart, Jon Favreau & Jon Lovett on Political Bubbles & Taking on Trump

name: Scare Tactics
summary: Scare Tactics will turn unsuspecting individuals into the main characters of their very own horror movies. This heart-pounding show offers a cinematic approach to the hidden camera concept. Set up by their friends and family, these unwitting participants are put in hilariously twisted scenarios with fully immersive stories that blur the lines of reality, horror and comedy. As they navigate one unreal decision after another, audiences will laugh, jump and be left breathless for more.

name: Match Fit
summary:
The new season of Match Fit is kicking off, mixing up the codes with Sir Graham Henry and Tawera Nikau.

The fourth season of Threes' Match Fit will see a clash of the codes, with former All Black coach Sir Graham Henry coaching ex-union legends and former league super star Tawera Nikau coaching ex-league legends.

name: The War Between the Land and the Sea
summary: When a fearsome and ancient species emerges from the ocean, dramatically revealing themselves to humanity, an international crisis is triggered. With the entire population at risk, UNIT step into action as the land and sea wage war.

name: Bahishkarana
summary:
In the 1990s Peddapalli, Pushpa, a courtesan arrives and becomes entangled with Shivaya, the village Sarpanch. Simultaneously, a secret affair blossoms between Pushpa and Darshi, Shivaya's henchman. As their relationship deepens, Darshi expresses his desire to marry Pushpa. Surprisingly, Shivaya agrees, but just as Pushpa and Darshi prepare for their new life together, unforeseen circumstances force Darshi into a marriage with Lakshmi, while Pushpa resumes her role as Shivaya's courtesan.

Darshi and Lakshmi's marriage begins and over time, they slowly develop a bond, and Lakshmi becomes pregnant. Their happiness is shattered when Darshi is wrongfully convicted of murder and sentenced to seven years in prison. Upon his release, Darshi discovers the truth of his imprisonment. Unfortunately, he gets killed by Shivaya which plunges both Pushpa and Lakshmi into turmoil. Lakshmi and Pushpa unite in their sorrow, finding strength to seek revenge against the sarpanch's cruelty.

name: Vought Rising
summary: A twisted murder mystery about the origins of Vought in the 1950s, the early exploits of Soldier Boy, and the diabolical maneuvers of a Supe known to fans as Stormfront, who was then going by the name Clara Vought.

name: tiny desk concerts JAPAN
summary: All you need is a small desk and musical instruments. NHK is launching a Japanese version of the worldwide phenomenon "tiny desk concerts," originally pioneered by American public broadcaster NPR. Set in the actual offices of NHK, the series will breathe new life into music as artists perform in a setting that is anything but ordinary.

name: Sandi's Great British Woodland Restoration
summary: British TV legend and QI host Sandi Toksvig and her wife Debbie have fulfilled their life-long dream of buying an ancient woodland. Dating from 1600, this beautiful 40-acre site is home to trees, streams, meadows, and a melting pot of species from fungi to foxes, lichens to little owls. But, as Sandi discovers, it's overgrown, diseased and in need of serious TLC. Can they save their wood?

name: The Jury Room
summary:
The Jury Room re-examines real murder cases in which convicted killers have always maintained their innocence. The accepted facts of each case are presented, as originally seen by the actual trial judge and jury, to twelve members of a specially selected jury. Ex-Detective Chief Inspector Colin Sutton represents the prosecution and barrister Matt Stanbury speaks for the defence, while renowned crime reporter Will Hanrahan helps the jury and the viewers to connect the dots.

Each sitting offers either revelatory new evidence, or a more advanced analysis of pre-existing evidence, that may influence the jury's judgment. The action unfolds in real time as the women and men in the jury room consider each defendant's fate.

name: Klara
summary: The crazy girl involved in an affair with a married man? Drinking, smoking and taking pills? Partying with her friend Wronka? Talking to her cat? Arguing with her eternally dissatisfied mother? Klara who has no husband, children or dog? Klara who can't sleep, Klara, who is many years old and has little time, Klara, who is a little afraid but has great courage to live, Klara, for whom love is more important than reason, and good sex is more important than a good name? Klara's Great Return!"

name: Believe
summary: Explore the people and history behind the world's largest and most influential religions, and delve into the rich tapestry of traditions, rituals, and customs to paint an understanding of how believers across the globe live their lives. Examine how these religions - Christianity, Islam, Judaism, Hinduism, and Buddhism came into being and how they shaped our world, focusing on their history and practices.

name: Atasco
summary: A night-time traffic jam disrupts the plans of thousands of citizens: thieves will not arrive in time to the jewelry store they intend to rob, crane operators will give up on their love affair, an ambulance driver will desperately search for a toilet, a food truck will not reach its destination... Comical, unexpected and emotional stories on the asphalt.

name: American Dynasty
summary: American Dynasty explores the most iconic family empires in American history. Each episode will focus on how the family first achieved fame and fortune —and reveal how the following generations fought to live up to the example set by their ancestors.

name: Shadrach
summary: When the Wilson family must leave the city to start over in a small town, a majestic horse unexpectedly comes into their lives, helping them discover the true meaning of hope, faith, and family.

name: Vidya Gaem Awards
summary: The Vidya Gaem Awards are a yearly event, featuring 4chan's "/v/ - Video Games" board voting on the best and worst in video games of the year. Hosts provide commentary on the winners and explain why they won. The award presentations also feature skits from creators in the community, and later shows feature game trailers from independent game developers.

name: Shaun Micallef's Eve of Destruction
summary: It's a talk show like no other: one question, two guests and the man everyone agrees is this country's least experienced interviewer. Join Shaun Micallef each week as he chats with his famous celebrity acquaintances about what's REALLY important to them.

previousepisode.name: Christmas Eve of Destruction: Luke McGregor, Steph Tisdell, John Foreman, Ella Hooper

name: Headhunted to Another World: From Salaryman to Big Four!
summary: Dennosuke Uchimura is just an ordinary Japanese salaryman, until he's sent to work in Vietnam where he dies in a hit-and-run accident. Uchimura is reincarnated and summoned to another world by the Demon King, who offers him a new job–as one of the Four Heavenly Kings of his army! Uchimura is faced with an offer he can't refuse, but can he do the job?

previousepisode.name: How to Find Your Way of Life

name: Переживу
summary:
"I will outlive everything and everyone," sang Monetochka. Her healing hit gave the name to Boris Barabanov's musical travel show, where artists in exile talk about their new lives.

Monetochka, "Nervy", "Pornofilmy", "AloeVera", Tequilajazzz and many others - they all condemned the full-scale military invasion of Russia in Ukraine. They all had to leave their homeland and face various difficulties. And they all found new paths for creativity.

name: The Last Time
summary: Ryu is a skilled young writer who has a girlfriend, Pin, who he's dated since high school. They love each other and plan to marry. But perhaps because of Ryu's fate, he loses her forever in a car accident. Ryu blames himself. He withdraws and starts leaning on alcohol. With the arrival of Arm, the grandson of the owner of the company where Ryu works, and their gradual relationship, Ryu's world begins to brighten again. When Ryu finds out that he has cancer and may not have long to live, Arm goes all in caring for him and the two decide to live together. However, the world is always cruel. When Arm and Ryu learn the truth of something that tears them apart, Ryu disappears from Arm's life. Arm tries every means to find Ryu without any luck, until finally, Arm gets a box. This box contains all the answers.

name: Sky Valley
summary: In the first tale, Junjun, a horseman working at the resort, finds himself irresistibly drawn to Fourth, a mysterious guest whose arrival stirs up deep emotions. The second story follows Paris, a vlogger from Manila, who falls for Taylor, the daughter of the resort's owner, sparking a passionate romance amidst the stunning backdrop of Sky Valley Park.

name: The Body Next Door
summary:
Nestled in the heart of the Welsh Valleys is the quiet former mining town of Beddau. Home to some 3000 residents. Beddau is a place where locals know the postman by name; and everyone knows everyone's business. Or so they think…; In 1997; Ann Sabine arrives in the Welsh town of Beddau from New Zealand. Single; with no family to speak of; she soon becomes the life and soul of the community; earning a reputation for having a ‘heart of gold'. Everyone loves her. But when Ann dies from cancer in 2015; and tells her friends to retrieve a medical skeleton from her shed for a; joke; her friends instead discover a heavily wrapped male corpse.

South Wales Police commence an investigation which unravels decades of secrets; rocking communities on both sides of the world.; This 3-part documentary series is packed with twists and turns; it's the tale of a seemingly gentle old lady with a dark and sinister past; one that will unravel across this gripping; and tonally refreshing; true crime feature / series.

name: Yorkshire By the Sea
summary: Celebrating the people and landscape of England's largest county, Yorkshire By the Sea follows the stories of everyday heroes and communities living and working in and around the spectacular Yorkshire coast.

name: Ethelbert the Tiger
summary: Ethelbert is an adventurous tiger cub who has always a question to present to his friend Dilip. Determined to show him the answer rather than telling him, Dilip takes him through the Magic Waterfall to different parts of the world. There, Ethelbert makes new friends and discovers new cultures and beautiful landscapes.

name: Gangland Chronicles
summary: Gangland Chronicles offers an inside look at some of the world's most notorious criminal organizations. Each episode explores three legendary moments from a specific underworld group, ranging from mafias and cartels to motorcycle gangs and prison gangs. The series spotlights lucrative money-making rackets, deadly turf wars, iconic mob hits, crafty informants, and federal takedowns. Featuring infamous gangsters such as Al Capone, Pablo Escobar, El Chapo, John Gotti, Whitey Bulger, and Sonny Barger. Interviews with journalists, authors, and former members of these organizations offer an exclusive window into the inner workings of these groups.

name: Dexter: Resurrection
summary: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

name: Ai no Nai Koibitotachi
summary: A love story surrounding 7 people in their thirties, who have distanced themselves from love for various reasons.

name: Mums on Strike
summary: How will families cope when the person doing the most leaves them to fend for themselves?

name: Game of Wool: Britain's Best Knitter
summary: Game of Wool: Britain's Best Knitter sees 10 ambitious creatives take on a series of complex challenges where they have the chance to win a money-can't-buy prize and be the UK's first TV knitting champion.

name: What's the Big Deal: Britain's Best Buys?
summary:
Across each episode, Natalie explores four talked about products -  from ice baths to teeth-whiteners. With behind-the-scenes access to scientists, nutritionists and industry insiders, Natalie will investigate how these products actually work and which ones she thinks are worth the hype. 

As Natalie gathers intel from a raft of experts, six charismatic British households are road-testing these products for themselves at home, then they'll give their honest opinion on which ones they'd buy.

name: Stayer
summary: Even Elstad, a washed-out rock star, returns to his hometown of Eidsvoll, facing a crucial choice of whether to make amends with his family and teenage daughter Annie or try to save what's left of his career.

name: Find My Country House
summary: Hosted by Trish Suhr, Find My Country House follows couples as they search for their piece of paradise by trying to find the perfect country home.

name: Den Gode Stemning
summary: Siblings Eva and Mads put a strain on their familial bonds as they try to come to terms with personal demons.

name: An Empty Dream
summary: A homebody named Suyan accidentally clicks on an online ad and stumbles into the demon world's capital city, Linyuan. Unexpectedly, he somehow becomes a demon king who doesn't know anything about magic. In order not to let others find out that he's a powerless pushover and get himself killed, Suyan decides to fawn on the powerful General Hua, whose power is only second to that of the Demon King. However, it turns out that General Hua is also a person who has traveled through time and space from the modern world. So the two moderners begin their journey of leveling up and battling monsters together in Linyuan City. They tame the mount, Silver Dragon, and outwit the demon world's high-ranking officials while concealing their identities. On the once-in-300-years Dengming Assembly, they promote talks between the monster clan's Young Master Yingri and the immortal realm's Lord Luzhen to forge peace across the three realms. Moreover, they manage to find the magical bead to restore the primordial spirit of Yuke, Suyan's rebellious and cunning younger brother. However, the disappearance of the magical bead leads to chaos in Linyuan City, threatening to destroy the demon world and forcing Suyan to finally make the most important decision as the Demon King.

name: Cinderella at 2 AM
summary: A drama about the love story of Ha Yoon Seo, a realist who believes that there is no Cinderella in reality, and Seo Joo Won, a romanticist who believes that conditions are not important in front of love.

name: Deha
summary: The events in the series revolve around Devran, whose father İskender discovered at a young age that he was a mathematical genius

name: Face to Face with Scott Peterson
summary: Face to Face with Scott Peterson takes a new look at the notorious case of Scott Peterson and the murders of his wife Laci Peterson and unborn son Conner. The docuseries will also follow the latest developments after the Los Angeles Innocence Project announced they were taking Scott's case in early 2024.

name: Live+Local
summary: A mockumentary about a morning radio show team at the inspirational yet rapidly declining radio station KHUGG-FM. Featuring hilarious behind the scenes drama with real-life celebrity guests.

name: The Wanderer
summary: It's 1958. World War II veteran Louis Valentini takes a traveling salesman job, selling jewelry to women across the continent. His past will soon get in the way of his girl, his career, and the law.

name: Home-Schooled
summary: A self-centered business woman, living in the city, is shocked to discover she has inherited five sheltered Home-Schooled kids in the Midwest.

name: The Encounter
summary: Get your adrenaline and your faith flowing with this Pure Flix original series about an authoritative, mysterious figure known only as 'The Man.'

name: Taken Together: Who Killed Lyric and Elizabeth?
summary: Known as "the case that haunts the Midwest," the series dives into the haunting 2012 double abduction of two cousins, 10-year-old Lyric Cook-Morrissey and 8-year-old Elizabeth Collins, in Evansdale, Iowa. With over seven years of exclusive access and insider interviews conducted by Sires, including an additional young girl who escaped her kidnapper against all odds, compelling footage of the two victim's families over a crucial passage of time and new information around the case, Taken Together: Who Killed Lyric and Elizabeth? offers a searing and unforgettable lens on this unimaginable crime.

name: Love is Like a Poison
summary: Ryoma Shiba, a genius lawyer, passed the bar exam with the highest score while still in college and became the youngest co-partner at a major law firm. He is highly valued as a legal advisor for many major clients. One day, Shiba meets a mysterious genius con artist, Haruto, at a bar. Shiba, who was looking for a capable work partner, is impressed by Haruto's talent for impersonation and decides to "keep" Haruto at his home. Shiba and his secret partner begin living together! Haruto, a sweetheart who does his best for his "owner" no matter the danger, gradually "poisons" Shiba, a novice in love, until Shiba finally falls for him…!? The two polar opposites form a secret buddy team, solving problems in thrilling ways. Eventually, they will face off against a great evil…

previousepisode.name: Fateful Judgement - A Holy Night's Gift

name: The Vacation in Koh Samui
summary: The Unintentional Love Story cast—Cha Seo Won, Gongchan, Won Tae Min, and Do Woo—are back in the travel show "The Vacation In Koh Samui"! Join them for fun and adventure in the tropical haven of Koh Samui, Thailand, starting on August 1 on Watcha!

name: Dance Moms: A New Era
summary: Dance Moms: A New Era is a reboot of the ever so popular Dance Moms. This time, with a new coach, new dancers and new mama drama. Introducing beloved dance coach, Glo Hampton, who wants to take her students and prestigious dance school Studio Bleu to the next level - competing nationally every week. But the road to glory won't be an easy one. Coach Glo must juggle her tiny but mighty dancers, their scheming moms, and ensuing meltdowns, all while ruling with a tender but tough iron fist. Will Glo and her dance team persevere amidst the dramatics?

name: Sons of Thunder: Redemption
summary: After being released from prison, a former biker gang member tracks down his ex-fiancé at a ranch on the brink of foreclosure to reconcile, but the biker gang that he betrayed isn't far behind him.

name: Finding Love in Quarantine
summary: Amid a crisis that has forced everyone into quarantine, Rick Baldwin is seeking sanity – and maybe even…. love?

name: Going Home
summary: It's a race against time as a dedicated Hospice nurse with her own complicated past, leads her new clients and their loved ones to wrap up loose ends with compassion and dignity before they go "home".

name: Saved By Grace
summary: Angels are amongst us and God has sent them on a mission to intercede on behalf of whispered prayers. Every encounter presents a new opportunity to change your approach to life.

name: ЛОК СТОК
summary: In life, it's not the smartest who wins, but the most confident one, welcome to the supposedly intellectual show - "LOCK STOCK"! (Lock Stock) In our show, there are two ways to win: either know the right answer for sure, or pretend better than anyone else that you know for sure! Only ONE will take the money!

name: Ангел мести
summary: Many years later, he returns to his hometown - the city of his losses - under a false name. Andrey built a tough plan for revenge on everyone responsible for the ruin of his fate. Former friends do not suspect that soon their prosperous, carefree life will come to an end and they will have to pay bills.

name: Shitsuren Hoken
summary: Ayumu Kazuki works as an assistant professor in the zoo ecology department for a university. He also has a secret side job. Ayumu works at night as an insurance investigator for a broken-heart insurance company. The company, run by effeminate Shinto priest Eitarou Tokura, charges approved customers 100 million yen to insure their love life after confessing their love to an appointed person (receiving ten times that amount in case they suffer heartbreak). Ayumu must use various psychological dating techniques to uncover customer's feelings.

previousepisode.name: Case 13 (Finale): Two answers ... the last confession

name: Furitsumore Kodokuna Shi yo
summary: The skeletal remains of 13 children were found in what is known as the "Haikawa Residence Incident." A mysterious mark left at the scene reappears seven years later, a mysterious communal life, a suspect known as "Father", six survivors of the incident, and layers of hidden truths. The unfolding mysteries lead to an unpredictable ending, the beginning of a human suspense story. Adapted from the manga series "Furitsumore Kodokuna Shi yo" (降り積もれ孤独な死よ) written by Inoryuu Hajime (井龍一) and illustrated by Itou Shouta (伊藤翔太).

name: Access All Areas
summary: Adventurer Francesca Chiorando travels around the world to places like Iceland and Morocco, and discovers some of the world's most challenging and terrifying places. She uncovers fascinating stories, meets remarkable people, and investigates long-standing mysteries: human and natural events that have puzzled communities for generations.

name: The Rules of Love Under the Moonlight
summary: College student Shang Ya Yue strays into a comic's world and meets its protagonist, the white nine-tailed fox Si Yan, and its villain, the black nine-tailed fox Yan Yu Nan. Which one will she choose?

name: Jigsaw John
summary: The series centered on John St. John (also known as "Jigsaw"), a detective with the Los Angeles Police Department who solves murder cases.

name: Wojenne dziewczyny
summary: The series tells the story of the difficult years of the Nazi occupation, seen from the perspective of three young Polish women. Marysia, Ewka and Irka are very young girls who, on the threshold of their adult lives, were dealt a war by fate – one of the most terrible wars that have befallen their country. They are not yet mothers, nor are they wives. Prepared for the first twenty years of childhood and youth to live according to the standards of their environment, they suddenly found themselves defenseless against the powerful forces of evil and darkness. And they decided to take up the fight against them. And for this fight to be effective, they must change and adapt to new conditions. Each of the heroines must face their own fears and the brutal reality of the occupation. Their stories are not only a fight for survival, but also a story of courage, sacrifice and solidarity.

name: Every Year After
summary: Carley Fortune's Every Year After is a romantic, nostalgic story of first loves and the people and choices that mark us forever.

name: 命剩仨月顾小姐放飞自我了
前妻撩人傅先生宠不停
Queen Woo
summary: Upon the announcement of the king's death in Goguryeo, a fierce battle ensues among tribes. Queen Woo, who immediately becomes the target of princes and five tribes vying for the throne, struggles to crown a new king within 24 hours. Will Queen Woo be able to transcend the constraints of gender and era to carve out her own destiny?

name: Love Is Blind: México
summary: Magical proposals. A idyllic retreat. A hefty dose of reality. The Emmy-nominated experiment arrives in Mexico to test if love truly is blind.

name: Pokémon: Trainer Tour
summary: The Trainer Tour team, Meghan Camarena, Andrew Mahone and their friend Pikachu, are hitting the road to help Trainers overcome personal challenges and evolve their Pokémon Trading Card Game skills. It's time to level up!

name: Dumas
summary: Nearly 30 years ago, Jean Dumas started his small business: Intelco. Over the years, minor investigations gave way to much more complex cases: intellectual property theft, industrial espionage, embezzlement, and money laundering. To carry out these missions, Dumas assembled a team of seasoned investigators from law enforcement. They accept mandates clearly defined by rigorous contracts, in accordance with the law. The family business has thus become one of the largest investigative firms in the country.

name: The 500
summary: The 500 follows a former con artist as he is plucked from his Harvard Law School classroom to become an associate at Washington's most high-powered consulting firm. Quickly pulled into a seductive, dangerous web of power and corruption, he struggles to find his way out.

name: Milkshake! Music Explorers
summary: Kemi takes a look at musical instruments from around the world.

name: Beyond Borders
summary: Series following the work of immigration and customs enforcement.

name: Stop! Young Castellan
summary: Wu Baobao, the daughter of Castellan of Wufengzhai, embarked on a quest to save her father and the villagers who had been poisoned by "Wuteng". She encountered Song Lian, a descendant of the witch physician, also known as the "Swashbuckler". Together, they began their search for the only antidote in the world, "Wuying". Along the way, they faced enemies together and supported each other, gradually uncovering that everything was part of a conspiracy orchestrated by Chatelain for his self-preservation. They also unraveled the mystery of Wu Baobao's true identity...

name: The Silent Rift
summary: A cold case, an 18-year-old robbery, resurfaces with an unexpected clue, and Meng Guangcai, a self-made tycoon at the height of his success, is suddenly arrested. The key to cracking the mystery is Zhu Helai, an unassuming veteran police officer who has spent years working quietly in the cafeteria. Meng Guangcai and his accomplices weave an intricate web of lies to outmaneuver Zhu Helai and the police. Then the complex and unpredictable fate of the two over the 28 years of their acquaintance unfolds...

name: Titanic in Colour
summary: The most famous ship ever and the fate of its doomed passengers and crew are brought to life in colour for the first time.

name: Their Wonderful Time
summary: When female game designer Song Lingling was accidentally possessed by the NPC she designed, she was forced to embark on a hilarious cohabitation life with "the client," Xiao Ran. As they worked together to fix the game's bugs, they also strove to fix their own "personal bugs." From being quarrelsome partners to genuinely appreciating each other, along with friends like Zhang Yunfei, they embarked on various adventures between the virtual and real worlds, developing a cross-dimensional romance! In the end, they all harvested valuable friendships and love.

name: Dating Naked UK
summary: In this ultimate dating experiment, the singles will be put to the test as the arrival of naked newbies will shift dynamics and relationship connections already formed. There will also be an array of sexy, hilarious and dramatic dates firing up the passion, and an epic ditching at the Dumping Ground in every episode as Rylan says Laters to the Daters. For those who make it to the end of the experience, there will be a big cash prize up for grabs. With emotions laid bare and romances unbuttoned, will any of them succeed in their quest to find love?

name: Fleadh24
summary: Irish music, song and dance staged in Wexford town. For eight days the streets bustle with performers, music lovers and those competing at Fleadh Cheoil na hÉireann. Presenters Doireann Ní Ghlacáin and Peadar Ó Goill travel the highways and byways, taking viewers on a trip across the four provincial finals in Strokestown, Wicklow, Thurles and Dromore to catch up with some of the country's emerging musical talent.

name: Scannal 20 Bliain
summary: Marking the 20th anniversary of Scannal with a look back at stories that have shaped Ireland over the past half-century, having shocked, appalled, entertained or outraged the nation.

name: Zhan Shen: Fanchen Shenyu
summary: The story follows Lin Qiye, a young man who navigates a society seemingly protected by gods, only to discover that ancient deities and monsters actually pose an active threat to humanity. To protect his city, he joins the "Night Watchmen"—an elite, secret organization of superpowered individuals who battle mythological threats. [1, 2, 3]

name: Atrévete a Soñar
summary: Patito, known as an ugly duckling in her high school meets her prince, Mateo and will go to any lengths to impress him. Meanwhile, Patito's mother stumbles upon a man she used to love, but now he is with another woman.

name: After The Ark
summary: Yael Tygiel and Adrian Snow take viewers behind the scenes of The Ark with exclusive interviews featuring the cast and crew of this exciting series.

name: Horror's Greatest
summary: Celebrating the very best the genre has to offer, Horror's Greatest is a deep dive into everything we love about horror. From fresh looks at classics to unearthing scores of hidden gems, this series has something for every fright film enthusiast. A gallery of ghoulish pros, including actors, directors, writers, composers, and special effects artists, draw on their unique knowledge to answer the big questions: What are the must-see films in horror's many sub-genres? What's the appeal of horror tropes, and how do today's filmmakers subvert our expectations? What shape does horror take in countries outside of the United States? The answers encompass the breath of the nightmares we watch for our entertainment.

name: Trespasses
summary:
1975, in a town outside Belfast. Whilst working one night behind the bar of her family pub, serving a mixed crowd including the locally stationed soldiers, Catholic schoolteacher Cushla meets Michael, an older Protestant married man, who often defends IRA suspects and is friends with cultured Bohemians who enrage and intrigue Cushla. Worlds apart, Cushla knows a relationship like this spells all kinds of trouble, but they are irresistibly drawn to one another.  

In a place where loose lips cost lives and danger lurks in the shadows, amidst the fear and paranoia, this illicit affair between Cushla and Michael ignites and burns bright...

name: Kanzen Muzai
summary: A lawyer is selected to be in charge of a retrial for a case surrounding the abduction and murder of a girl in Kagawa Prefecture 21 years prior. At around the same time, another kidnapping case arises in which a young girl is also abducted with no charges being filled, making Chisa one of the victims. With this, she sets foot in her hometown of Kagawa for the first time in 10 years and, with the help of her colleague, reinvestigates the incident that had occurred at the time, where there is a high possibility that the perpetrator was responsible for the same incident, having Chisa confront the suspect who may have once tried to kill her in order to uncover the truth behind the incident.

name: The Getaway
summary: On a drive across the American West, six creators must weed out the "snitch" sabotaging their $10,000 prize. The twist? They're all the snitch

name: Club Friday The Series 16: Love Bully
Conquistadors: The Rise and Fall
summary: The fascinating and murky story of the Spanish Empire's conquest of the New World.

name: Город тайн
summary: Due to a childhood head injury, the investigator of the IC Alexey Platov is unable to feel feelings. He grew up calm, reasonable and lonely. It would seem that this is an advantage in his work, but the lack of any emotions does not give him the opportunity to build normal relationships with colleagues and superiors. One day Platov goes to businessman Miller to get dirt on influential people of the city and his colleagues from the UK, but finds him in a pool of blood, who died an obviously violent death. One of the police officers who arrived on call turns out to be Lieutenant Polina Lavrova. From that moment on, she, along with the emotionless Platov, begins to fight corruption in the local IC and the police.

name: Summerwater
summary: Set against the backdrop of a remote loch-side Scottish holiday cabin park and set over the course of one single rainy summer's day, Summerwater looks at the simmering tensions between holidaymakers that eventually erupt into a devastating climax. Weaving together the lives of several families as they navigate unspoken conflicts, private dilemmas, and fleeting moments of beauty from their disparate cabins, the series will take an unflinching but empathetic look at human nature across generations.

name: Jay Blades: A Country House Through Time
summary:
Jay Blades: A Country House Through Time explores the ins and outs of life upstairs and downstairs over the last 200 years, at beautiful Weston Park in Shropshire. In each episode, Jay delves into a different era, exploring the history of the Bridgeman family and staff who lived there. 

The series begins in Georgian times, when the Bridgeman family first moved in. It continues through the Victorian and Edwardian era, ending with the Second World War.

name: Extraordinary Australia
summary: Australia is a realm of thriving habitats and captivating natural wonders, from lush rainforests and dry eucalyptus woodland to vibrant coral reefs and isolated islands. On land and at sea, epic wildlife migrations, mesmerizing mating rituals and battles between predator and prey play out in a country like no other.

name: Defying Death
summary: Survivors of wild animal attacks, natural disasters, and catastrophic crashes share their first-hand accounts of bravery in the face of death.

name: Cabocla
summary: Set in Vila da Mata, in 1918, the plot revolves around the dispute over land between two colonels and the love between Luís Jerônimo and the cabocla Zuca, fiancée of the fearless Tobias.

name: Encontro com Patrícia Poeta
summary: With varied and current topics, Encontro is a plural space for interaction with the public.

name: MTV Dark Scroll
summary: India's only Paranormal reality show MTV Dark Scroll gears up to take 9 contestants on a haunted adventure in the eerieness of the mountains led by Amit Sadh.

name: Destination Divas
summary: A women empowerment foodie & lifestyle travel show.

name: Maruhi no Mitsuko-san
summary: Motomiya Mitsuko is a mysterious total coordinator. To get what her client wants, she changes their visuals from head to toe and also their mentality through coaching. Using any means necessary, she always makes her client successful. Her next client is Imai Natsu, who is a single mother with a string of bad luck. Imai Natsu's aim is to become the president of a large company that is run by a family. Meanwhile, Motomiya Mitsuko has a secret.

name: Normali
summary: Noam is a 24-year-old columnist struggling to establish himself as a writer, and not lose his mind in the process. A challenging task since his father is famous not only for his great talent as a writer, but also for his outrageous borderline personality. When Noam hits rock bottom fueled by a deadly combination of drugs, he finds his own route to normality in the unlikeliest of places: the psych ward.

name: All Town Aren't We
summary: Grimsby Town FC, once a high-flying football club with a proud history, is now on the brink of relegation from the Football League. The impending threat of semi-professional football looms on for not just the club, but an entire community. Witness one of the most breathtaking sporting stories of all time play out at Grimsby Town FC.

previousepisode.name: The Handy DIY Cheapskate and The Cheapskate Traveler

name: Legends of Avantris
summary: We're seven best friends creating tabletop roleplaying stories in an epic, interconnected universe. Join us.
